description: Frozen settings for Experiment 2. The runner applies host_overrides to the host's in-memory configuration at start-up (settings.json on disk is not modified) and records this whole file in every trial.

verification.note: When disabled the verifier is still called once so its verdict can be compared with the geometric rule, but no correction is executed.

battery.note: Set from the dry runs: the battery fell from 3.9 V to about 3.64 V over 8 trials with no loss of accuracy. Recharge or swap when the window shows < 3.65 V.

parallax_note: Marker-height parallax correction fitted on 2026-10-18 to 5 tape points (scale 1.0377, nadir (858, -970) mm, equivalent camera height 1513 mm for the 55 mm marker). Camera vs tape: 64.5 mm mean before, 2.6 mm mean (5.8 mm max) after. Blocks are flat and need no correction.
